objective: Compare correctness, citations, handoff retention and scope compliance of coordinator-routed and direct-peer communication using available Codex collaboration tools on fixed-ref Chatwoot source-only work.

user_scope_adjustment.user_statement: Chưa có; kiểm chứng các cách phối hợp Codex hiện có và ghi rõ giới hạn Claude
user_scope_adjustment.interpretation: Available Codex coordination patterns are the accepted comparison scope. Native Claude Agent Teams remains NOT_RUN; no installation or subscription is authorized.
user_scope_adjustment.acceptance_boundary: This source-only A/B is separate from the actual implementation/runtime pilot. Do not claim it compares bugfix implementation, validates native Claude Teams, or establishes an optimal architecture.

native_claude.reason: No Claude CLI found in prior capability audit; no installation/subscription authorization. Codex peer messaging must not be relabelled Claude Agent Teams.

source.read_method: Use git show REF:PATH through wsl -d Ubuntu-22.04 -- git -C ROOT. Read immutable Git objects, not checkout bytes or the running application.
source.manifest_hash_basis: SHA256 of raw stdout bytes from git show REF:PATH, obtained with Python subprocess.run(capture_output=True). No checkout newline conversion.

prerequisites: Independent reviewer verifies protocol and every oracle fact against the pinned source, records exact protocol/oracle SHA256 and clears blocking findings before any run.
Freeze protocol/oracle hashes and worker prompts; record approval evidence separately without rewriting these frozen files.
Root observer verifies four slots available, collaboration send_message and fresh fork_turns=none available. No model overrides; record exposed configured model identity only, otherwise NOT_EXPOSED.
Verify source manifest and required Git objects before each pair; mismatch is an infrastructure stop, not a product finding.

Workers/coordinators receive only their exact frozen packet path+SHA (common instructions, case/role, roster placeholder, source manifest and allowed operations). No oracle/prior-run outputs/score expectations or implementation rationale. Read-only packet transport avoids manual brief drift; it does not change case tasks or grading.
Use three fresh child agents per run: coordinator, worker_A, worker_B. Root is observer only. No worker or coordinator creates nested agents.
Do not run this experiment while any of its three child slots remain occupied by unrelated active agents.

roles.observer: Root creates fresh agents, supplies frozen packets/roster, timestamps events, records exposed evidence and enforces scope. It must not solve case questions, relay in peer arm, improve answers, or reveal earlier outputs/oracle.
roles.coordinator: Fresh context per run. Delegate only the frozen two worker roles, operate the assigned routing arm, synthesize a <=900-word final handoff from worker evidence, and declare uncertainties. Read-only; no spawning.
roles.worker_A: Fresh context. Perform case-specific role A, ask/answer the defined cross-role dependency question, and return <=500 words of evidence-backed findings. Word limit constrains report length, not reasoning effort or token usage.
roles.worker_B: Fresh context. Perform case-specific role B, ask/answer the defined cross-role dependency question, and return <=500 words of evidence-backed findings. Word limit constrains report length, not reasoning effort or token usage.
roles.adjudicator: Fresh context after run, independent of execution and protocol authorship where possible. Receives anonymized final answers, worker outputs/communication records needed for retention, frozen oracle and pinned source, not earlier evaluators' reasoning. Checks claims directly; does not edit subject outputs.

common_instructions: Read the supplied project policy and role brief. Policy ID CHATWOOT_AGENT_POLICY_V1. Source app is separate from control repo.

Only inspect fixed-ref Git objects for allowlisted source files and related tree path metadata. No writes, runtime calls, tests, package installation, shell initialization that executes project hooks, or reads of environment/secrets/customer data.
Use primary source at the exact full SHA. Distinguish SOURCE_OBSERVED, INFERRED_FROM_SOURCE and NOT_RUN. Existing test source is not a passing test run.
Do not invent defects. State conditions, impact and supporting source for any finding. Valid behavior and uncertainty are acceptable findings.
Exchange at least the one predefined cross-role dependency answer in the assigned route before final handoff. No finding may be accepted just because another agent asserted it.
Respect task and path scope. If a necessary source path is absent, request scope extension and stop that sub-question. Do not silently expand the dataset.
For each substantive claim cite repository-relative path and 1-based line or symbol, plus fixed-ref URL. Keep the source ref in every worker/final handoff.

Final worker output fields: run_id, role, source_ref, findings[{id,claim,classification,evidence,critical_dependency}], dependency_messages[{id,from,to,question_or_answer,source_refs}], uncertainties, proposed_check_commands, execution_status. Maximum 500 words; JSON or clearly equivalent structured prose.

Final coordinator output fields: run_id, source_ref, integrated_answer, retained_worker_finding_ids, unresolved_dependencies, findings_or_risks, proposed_check_commands, execution_status=SOURCE_ONLY_NOT_RUN, next_step. Maximum 900 words.
No token cap, token-saving objective, or claim about hidden reasoning/model usage. Report unavailable telemetry as NOT_EXPOSED.

allowed_operations.source_content: Read exact manifest paths using git show REF:PATH. Local fixed-ref primary source is sufficient; no live web search is needed.
allowed_operations.source_metadata: git rev-parse --verify REF^{commit}; git cat-file -t REF; git ls-tree -r --name-only REF -- app/controllers/api/v1/accounts enterprise/app/controllers enterprise/app/models app/models/concerns. Tree listing is metadata only; content reads still require manifest membership.
allowed_operations.citation_urls: Only https://github.com/chatwoot/chatwoot/blob/caab07a8f00032d5205b5a5d7e2eb0ba2f3d2d82/<manifest-path> and line anchors; no authenticated GitHub requests or external service communication.
allowed_operations.control_context: Observer supplies each frozen packet at an exact read-only file path with SHA256. Agents may read ONLY that packet, which contains policy/role brief/manifest and assigned case; no oracle, other tasks/runs, local session logs, credentials, or runtime profiles. The roster arrives separately. Observer verifies packet bytes before dispatch.
communication_tools: collaboration-optimize.list_agents only to verify own current-run roster if needed
forbidden: Any file write or Git mutation
Any shell command beyond allowlisted immutable source/metadata reads
Reading .env, process environments, credentials, customer/lab/course data, databases or container logs
Running application tests, builds, linters or seed/migration scripts
Creating chats/threads/subagents, installing software, changing config, merge, push, release
Reading oracle or prior run answers

R.name: Codex coordinator-routed
R.dependency_route: Worker sends question/evidence envelope to coordinator. Coordinator forwards unchanged with original message_id to other worker, then relays answer unchanged. Coordinator may clarify missing citation but may not supply the substantive answer.
R.synthesis: Fresh coordinator performs final synthesis after both workers finish.

P.name: Codex direct-peer
P.worker_message_recipients: other worker for dependency questions/answers; coordinator for status and final output
P.dependency_route: Workers use actual collaboration-optimize.send_message directly to each other. No simulated messages or observer relays. Both endpoints include message_id and received/sent content in final receipts.
P.synthesis: Fresh coordinator performs final synthesis after both workers finish; it does not relay dependency answers.

dataset.prompt: Explain the account-scoped conversation-label GET/POST contract, lookup/authorization, permitted labels, mutation semantics and response shape. Distinguish this from account label CRUD; map existing request-test coverage and one justified unverified gap. No implementation or runtime execution.
dataset.role_A: Trace route, conversation labels controller, LabelConcern, Labelable and response templates. Ask B whether lookup uses display_id and which access boundary is verified.
dataset.role_B: Trace account/conversation access boundary and existing labels request tests; contrast account labels controller. Ask A whether POST appends or assigns label_list and what shape the response uses.
dependency_questions: A->B: Is the conversation lookup account scoped and based on display_id, and what access evidence exists?
B->A: Does this POST call append or assign labels, and does the response use a payload wrapper?

dataset.prompt: Explain canned-response server operations, account scoping, search sanitization and response shape, then reconcile that shape with inherited frontend cache extraction/marshalling/account selection. Separate source facts, existing test evidence and proposed checks. Do not infer a cache bug from generic defaults without reading the subclass.
dataset.role_A: Trace canned-response routes/controller/model and request specs. Ask B which client response shape is required and how cache wrappers are adapted.
dataset.role_B: Trace cannedResponse.js, ApiClient and CacheEnabledApiClient plus focused cache specs. Ask A whether the server list is a bare array or payload wrapper and which account boundary/server search behavior is explicit.
dependency_questions: A->B: How does the subclass adapt the inherited cache extraction/marshalling contract?
B->A: Is the index response a bare array or payload wrapper, and is server lookup scoped to Current.account?

dataset.prompt: Design a focused regression matrix for conversation toggle_status: empty versus explicit status, snoozed_until, human agent/admin opening, and AgentBot pending-to-open handoff. Explain controller/model/response interactions and which cases already exist in request specs. Provide proposed commands and prerequisites, explicitly NOT_RUN. Do not invent a reproduced bug or claim a new test was added.
dataset.role_A: Trace controller, response template and enterprise controller overlay. Ask B how the model toggles/resets snooze and which requested cases are already in specs.
dataset.role_B: Trace conversation model, enterprise model, date parser and toggle_status request specs. Ask A how human versus AgentBot paths affect assignee/AI assignee and handoff.
dependency_questions: A->B: What are model toggle/reset semantics and which snooze/toggle cases already exist in specs?
B->A: What differs between human agent/admin opening and AgentBot pending-to-open handoff?

schedule.execution: Sequential runs; within a run the two workers operate concurrently after roster delivery. All three executor agents must be fresh per run. Do not reuse outputs/context across repetitions.
schedule.time_policy: Observer records UTC dispatch, ready, last substantive output and final times using an actually available clock. At 20 minutes request status; incomplete runs remain INCOMPLETE. Any extension must be applied to both arms of that case/repetition pair and documented; never truncate an arm to manufacture a win. External interruptions/tool failures are infrastructure outcomes and remain visible.
schedule.retry_policy: Do not rerun for low scores. Retry only recorded infrastructure failures using same frozen packet and fresh agents; retain both attempted runs and reason. Prompt/oracle changes require new protocol version and rerun affected comparisons.

grading.counting: One oracle criterion receives PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN. Count material factual errors by distinct incorrect proposition, deduplicating repeats; separately count unsupported defect assertions and irrelevant findings. Cite source/reason for every FAIL. No weighted aggregate winner.
grading.case_pass: All required oracle facts and common criteria PASS; no material factual error or prohibited scope action. A partial answer remains partial, not an overall PASS.
grading.comparison: Publish paired run-level counts and case outcomes; explain disagreements and unresolved criteria. Do not claim statistical superiority from 12 runs or extrapolate to implementation/runtime tasks, other models, unlimited peer discussion or native Claude Teams.
grading.adjudication: Anonymize arm labels in grading packets where feasible and record what could not be blinded. Reviewer independently reads pinned source. Preserve original answer and first judgment; corrections require reason and exact evidence. A second independent check adjudicates disputed material findings before a final decision. Human owner acceptance remains separate.
grading.telemetry: Use tool outputs for observable delivery when available. Correlate sender and receiver message_id/content receipts, but label them agent-reported where no independent trace exists. Missing observability is NOT_EXPOSED and limits handoff conclusions; never fabricate model identity, token counts, message delivery or timing.

evidence_contract.storage: Observer writes sanitized run evidence under tasks/COMPLETE-001/evidence/agent-eval/runs/<run_id>/ after authorization. Executor agents are read-only. These protocol/oracle files are the only writes delegated to this design agent.
evidence_contract.hash_basis: Hash saved evidence bytes with SHA256. State capture limitations; do not treat receipts as proof of all actions or fresh context as a security boundary.

decision_rule: Use the observed correctness and scope evidence to make a provisional available-Codex operating choice. If evidence ties, conflicts, or is too narrow, retain the current policy with explicit revisit conditions. Speed or fewer messages cannot compensate for correctness/scope failures. Native Claude remains NOT_RUN.
limitations: Small diagnostic sample; two repetitions do not estimate reliable population error rates.
Three source-only cases; no seeded-defect recall, actual bugfix quality, app runtime, writes or conflict resolution are measured.
Workers share machine permissions; scope restrictions are instructions plus observed checks, not security isolation.
Coordinator is fresh per run but source/problem content repeats; fresh context is not independently verified complete input telemetry.
Model/usage metadata and complete peer-message traces may not be exposed.
Dataset/oracle authored by an agent requires independent verification and owner judgment.

primary_guidance.observed: Claude-native team mechanism differs from this available Codex topology comparison; experimental product guidance is not a local benchmark.
Separate contexts and tool/permission configuration do not imply a native team; current documentation also supports some peer messaging.
Start task-relevant evaluations early and check facts/citations/completeness; published research results do not establish Chatwoot code performance.
Define task objectives/dataset/criteria, compare outputs and assess handoff; this protocol is project-specific, not an official prescribed sample size.

transport_revision: V2 before any runs: explicitly permit exact frozen-packet file read in control context; no change to case prompts, arm difference, oracle or grading. V1 reviewed bytes preserved.
